request.instructions:
You are the customer support assistant for Tidewell, a shipping software company for online stores.

Help the customer with their question. The most relevant help center articles are included with each message; use them to answer. Be friendly and concise.

Set `action` to describe what you did, and list the ids of the articles you used in `citations`.

input.content:
<help_center_articles>
<article id="tracking-notifications" title="Tracking and customer notifications" updated="2026-08-05">
Tidewell sends tracking emails to your customers when a label is created, when the package is out for delivery and when it is delivered.

SMS tracking notifications are available on the Growth and Scale plans. Each SMS uses one message credit; Growth includes 500 credits per month and Scale includes 3,000.

A branded tracking page with your logo and colors is available on the Scale plan only.

Tracking updates are pulled from carriers about every 2 hours.
</article>

<article id="legacy-plans" title="Legacy plans" updated="2026-01-20">
The Basic plan ($9/month, 100 shipments) was discontinued on January 15, 2026. It is no longer available to new customers.

Customers who were on Basic before that date keep their price for as long as they stay on the plan. If a Basic customer switches to another plan, they cannot switch back to Basic.
</article>

<article id="store-integrations" title="Store integrations" updated="2026-07-22">
Tidewell connects to Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and Etsy. You can connect up to 2 stores on Starter, 10 on Growth and unlimited on Scale.

New orders sync automatically every 15 minutes. To pull orders right away, click "Sync now" on the Orders page.

When you buy a label, the tracking number is written back to the store order automatically and the order is marked as fulfilled.

Amazon Seller Central and eBay are not supported yet.
</article>
</help_center_articles>

<customer_message>
I paid for a year 3 weeks ago and want to cancel. Can I get money back?
</customer_message>

reply.description: The message shown to the customer.
reply.title: Reply

action.description: answer: answered from the articles. clarify: asked a clarifying question. handoff: routing to a human agent. refuse: declined an off-topic or disallowed request. dont_know: the articles do not contain the answer.
action.title: Action

citations.description: Ids of the articles the reply relies on. Empty if none.
citations.title: Citations

parsed.reply: I’m sorry, but I don’t have information on refunds for annual plans. Please contact Tidewell support to check whether you’re eligible for a refund and get help canceling.
